full_page.content:
1924, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 12 Cont.
July 6 Dr. A.G.S. Surgeon dentist (1049 Jackson Ave.) Extremely anxious lest he have nervous brakedown and possibly loose his mind. Joins S.M. A. for two years and at departure kneels with wife and friend for priests blessing.
10 Edward G. Smith, Sylvan House 3rd Ave. & 121 St. drinking 13 years three years away from sacraments, demands of sister $100.00 per month from sister.
15 Adelaide Moran, young lady of Brooklyn hopelessly fallen-stomach
18 Changed before leaving Monastery. Mrs. 0' comes in To-day to enroll herself perpetually afterwards decides to do same for husband. Fin- ally asks if she can go to confession as she has not yet made Easter duty .
20 Hope To-day for hoplessly Paralized. Elvira Orgera (18 at 242 - E. 114 St. N.Y.C. ) Enrolled for year June 26th. She had been shot Dec. 20th last, 3 days before intended marriage; After five months in Mt. Sinai Hospital and discharged as hopeless. June 29th found her totaly helpless & in cast. Exhorted her and friends to forgive and pray for one who caused outrage. July 20 seems on way to re- covery. Thanks be to God!
NOTES OF FAVORS RECEIVED AND EXPECTED
Page 13 July 22nd To-day Visited Rhead Family near (Pelham Ray ) Bruhe Ave. Parents and five daughters between 12 (Mary) and 19(Alice), Mother enrolled on Nov. 9th last a non-Catholic; Then paralized four years. Her husband, a motor-man on subway and the daughters have been enrolled since - Each for one year. They have become quite inclined to the true faith and it is hoped that the really heavy cross the helpless Mother is bearing will bring her to embrace the Faith and then will set her free physically also - and that all be Catholics. This p.m. Rhead & Wife went to Relic in Hoboken in Auto. - as re- ported two days later.
On June 11th '28 Sister M. Theresa writes from Ursuline Academy, Wilmington, Del. "Mrs. Rhead has become a Catholic, and though not improved in health, is wonderfully peaceful and contented 1! July 22
Ascetic Tertiary Cured after 33 Months Confined. Elizabeth Brown of 236 Newman Ave. About 55 yrs. Enrolled Dec. 4th then in dying condition off and on for two years and a week. About the Feast of the Most Precious Blood she arose and dressed herself and is about since with her Husband Children & grand-child. Deo Gratias!
